<function name="TranslateValues" parent="DSlider" type="panelhook">
	<description>For override by child panels, such as <page>DNumSlider</page>. Allows changing the output values of the slider.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="x" type="number">The input X coordinate, in range of 0-1.</arg>
		<arg name="y" type="number">The input Y coordinate, in range of 0-1.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The output X coordinate, in range of 0-1.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">The output X coordinate, in range of 0-1.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
